items.title: Coco – Special KIDS Halloween Show
items.overview: Coco is a 2017 animated fantasy adventure following 12-year-old Miguel, who is accidentally transported to the colourful Land of the Dead. With the help of his ancestors, he embarks on a magical journey to uncover his family’s story and find his way home. A colourful, heartwarming adventure perfect for our Kids Halloween Show under the stars!

items.title: Weapons – Special Halloween Show
items.overview: Weapons is a 2025 supernatural mystery horror film directed by Zack Cregger. When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanishes at exactly the same time, a community is left searching for answers. 🔞 Halloween horror under the stars, strictly for guests aged 18 and over.

items.title: Song Sung Blue
items.overview: Song Sung Blue is a 2025 biographical musical drama starring Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson as Mike and Claire Sardina, a couple who form the Neil Diamond tribute band Lightning & Thunder. Based on a true story, the film follows their journey through musical success, love and devastating heartbreak, all brought to life through the timeless songs of Neil Diamond.

items.title: Crazy Rich Asians
items.overview: Crazy Rich Asians is a 2018 American roma-com drama film directed by Jon M. Chu. The film stars Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Gemma Chan, Lisa Lu, Awkwafina, Ken Jeong, and Michelle Yeoh. It follows a Chinese-American professor, Rachel, who travels to Singapore with her boyfriend Nick and is shocked to discover that Nick’s family is one of the richest families in Singapore.

items.title: Dirty Dancing
items.overview: Dirty Dancing is a 1987 American romantic drama dance film, starring Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey. It tells the story of Frances “Baby” Houseman (Grey), a young woman who falls in love with dance instructor Johnny Castle (Swayze) at a vacation resort.

items.title: Pride & Prejudice
items.overview: Pride & Prejudice is a 2005 historical romantic drama film based on Jane Austen’s 1813 novel of the same name. The film features five sisters from an English family of landed gentry as they deal with issues of marriage, morality and misconceptions. Sparks fly when spirited Elizabeth Bennet meets single, rich, and proud Mr. Darcy. But Mr. Darcy reluctantly finds himself falling in love with a woman beneath his class. Can each overcome their own pride and prejudice?

items.title: Mean Girls
items.overview: Mean Girls is a 2004 teen comedy starring Lindsay Lohan and Rachel McAdams. The film follows Cady Heron, a naïve teenager who enters an American high school after years of homeschooling in Africa and soon finds herself caught up with Regina George and the infamous Plastics. On Wednesdays, we wear pink! Feel free to dress up, with prizes for the best dressed.

items.title: Ordinary Angels
items.overview: Ordinary Angels is a 2024 American Christian drama film. Inspired by the incredible true story of a hairdresser who single-handedly rallies an entire community to help a widowed father to save the life of his critically ill young daughter. Directed by Jon Gunn, it stars Hilary Swank, Alan Ritchson, Nancy Travis and Tamala Jones.

items.title: Kal Ho Naa Ho – Dog Friendly Show
items.detail_title: Kal Ho Naa Ho – Dog Friendly Show
items.overview: Kal Ho Naa Ho is a 2003 Bollywood rom-com-drama starring Shah Rukh Khan, Saif Ali Khan and Preity Zinta. Set in New York City, it follows Naina, who falls for her charming new neighbour Aman, unaware that a heartbreaking secret prevents him from returning her love. Instead, Aman sets out to bring Naina and her best friend Rohit together in a story filled with romance, humour, music and emotion.
